DAMAGE MODEL — RIDGELINE v. NORTHSTAR ANALYTICS
Prepared by: Ridgeline Finance & Legal, October 30, 2024.
Purpose: Internal work product to quantify exposure and demand.

I. DIRECT DAMAGES
   A. Fees paid to Provider under SOW No. 1 through M2 ....... $240,000
   B. Cost to remediate corrupt telemetry / rebuild ingestion:
      - Emergency third-party integrator (Vector Systems) .... $186,400
      - Ridgeline internal engineering hours (1,240 @ $145) ... $179,800
      - Replacement edge-collector hardware .................... $62,000
   Direct-damages subtotal ................................... $668,200

II. INCIDENTAL DAMAGES
   Sourcing, vendor evaluation, and interim manual reporting .. $47,900

III. CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES (foreseeable — communicated
     in February 6 - February 8, 2024 email thread, and in
     Sections 1 and 2 of SOW No. 1)
   A. Lost yield on Line B, August 30 - October 15, 2024,
      measured against Line A control ..................... $1,940,000
   B. Late-delivery penalties owed to two automotive
      customers (contractual, invoiced) ..................... $412,000
   C. Rework and scrap tied to corrupt telemetry ............. $206,300
   Consequential-damages subtotal ......................... $2,558,300

IV. LIMITATION-OF-LIABILITY ANALYSIS (Section 5 of MSA)
   The MSA excludes "indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or
   punitive damages" and caps aggregate liability at fees paid in the
   preceding 12 months. Fees paid in the 12 months preceding the claim
   equal $240,000.

V. THEORY-BY-THEORY RECOVERY
   Contract (MSA governs, cap applies) ....................... $240,000
   Independent tort - fraudulent inducement (if pleaded and
      proven; would defeat contractual cap and disclaimers -
      confer with outside counsel) ......................... $3,274,400
   UCC (does not apply - services contract, common law only) ....... N/A

VI. NOTE
   Massachusetts arbitration clause in Aperture acknowledgment
   (unrelated PO) is not implicated in the Northstar dispute. The
   Northstar MSA specifies Delaware law and Delaware forum.
